description: This Python source file implements a class called UserIdleProcessor for detecting user inactivity (idle state) within a chatbot or interactive system. It manages timers and callbacks to notify or handle situations where the user has been inactive for a specified timeout period. The class utilizes asyncio for asynchronous operations and integrates with a frame processing pipeline, reacting to different frame types such as speaking or function call frames to accurately determine user idleness.
